# xray_watch_policy_attachment (Resource)

Provides an Xray Watch Policy Attachment resource. Attaches a single policy to a watch as a standalone resource so the policy can be detached and deleted without destroying the watch.

[API documentation](https://www.jfrog.com/confluence/display/JFROG/Xray+REST+API#XrayRESTAPI-UpdateWatch).

~> Manage a given watch's policies with **either** this resource **or** the `assigned_policy` block on `xray_watch`, not both. Using both for the same watch causes them to fight over the watch's policy list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xray_security_policy" "example" {
  name = "my-security-policy"
  type = "security"

  rule {
    name     = "min-severity-rule"
    priority = 1
    criteria {
      min_severity = "High"
    }
    actions {
      block_download {
        unscanned = true
        active    = true
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "xray_watch" "example" {
  name        = "my-watch"
  description = "My watch"
  active      = true

  watch_resource {
    type = "all-repos"
  }

  # Note: no `assigned_policy` block here - policies are attached via
  # xray_watch_policy_attachment below so they can be detached independently.
}

resource "xray_watch_policy_attachment" "example" {
  watch_name  = xray_watch.example.name
  policy_name = xray_security_policy.example.name
  policy_type = "security"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_name` (String) Name of the policy to attach.
- `policy_type` (String) The type of the policy - `security`, `license` or `operational_risk`.
- `watch_name` (String) Name of the watch to attach the policy to.

### Optional

- `project_key` (String) Project key of the watch. Must be 2 - 10 lowercase alphanumeric and hyphen characters.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```sh
terraform import xray_watch_policy_attachment.example watch-name:policy-name:security
```

### Import with `project_key`

To import an attachment that is in the scope of a project, include the project key as a trailing segment, separated by a colon (`:`):

```sh
terraform import xray_watch_policy_attachment.example watch-name:policy-name:security:my-project
```
